I've visited your beautiful country many times and still in touch with my former team. On the creative side, you will take raw field footage (GoPro, iPhone, and 4K aerial drone clips) captured by our crews in the DMV area and engineer high-engagement, highly satisfying short-for ---------- dia. You will be responsible for editing, annotating, and deploying content daily. On the systems side, you will act as our operational data anchor—translating scanned daily field sheets from our technicians into organized, actionable records within our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform and our dedicated safety/i ---------- tracking system. Core Responsibilities 1. CRM Administration & Field Data Processing Daily Work Sheet Ingestion: Review scanned copies of daily employee project worksheets submitted by our field crews. Accurately transcribe and enter key data points into our CRM system, including: Project Documentation: Transcribing general field notes, structural observations, and pre-existing property conditions. Labor Tracking: Logging precise project start and stop times to maintain accurate job-costing metrics. Chemical Application Logs: Recording exact chemical mixes used on site (e.g., Sodium Hypochlorite ratios, surfactants, or specialized neutralizers) and tracking raw material consumption. I ---------- & Safety Tracking: Review field sheets for any reported field anomalies, near-misses, or equipment failures. Extract and log this critical data into our dedicated i ---------- and a ---------- management tracking tool to support our proactive risk-mitigation protocols. Lead Management & Inbound Nurturing: Monitor incoming leads arriving in the CRM database. Manage initial client touchpoints exclusively via professional text and email communication (no voice calls required) to qualify leads and guide them cleanly into our bidding pipeline. 2. Social Media Creation & Daily Management Daily Multi-Platform Posting: Execute a rigorous, daily posting schedule across platforms critical to the Washington D.C. Metro market (Facebook , Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts). Video Engineering & Editing: Take raw, unedited footage of satisfying cleaning sequences (before/after transformations, drone flight lines, surface cleaning arcs) and cut them into pristine, high-impact vertical videos (9:16) using tools like CapCut, Adobe Premiere, or DaVinci Resolve. Media Annotation & Value Inlays: Add clean, professional text overlays, captioning, trending audio tracks, and graphic callouts (using Canva and advanced video effects) that educate the audience on how and why we clean scientifically. Local Brand Positioning: Tailor captions and hashtags to resonate with property managers, HOAs, commercial real estate developers, and high-end homeowners in the Northern Virginia, D.C., and Maryland corridors. 3. Brand Safety & Technical Integrity Gatekeeping PPE & OSHA Compliance Review: Review all raw field footage prior to editing to guarantee our brand exhibits 100% safety compliance. You will actively screen out any footage showing technicians violating safety protocols (e.g., missing eye/face protection, improper respirator use during chemical transfer, or lack of fall protection/harnesses on roof pitches). Chemical & Technical Accuracy: Ensure all video annotations and captions use accurate industry terminology. You will be trained by our leadership to distinguish between high-pressure blasting and low-pressure chemical softwashing, ensuring captions accurately explain how our chemical applications safely eliminate organic contaminants down to the spore without damaging delicate building materials. Required Skills & Experience Data Integrity & Speed: Exceptional accuracy and speed in data entry. Ability to read handwritten or scanned field worksheets and carefully extract technical data without errors. Software Mastery: Proficient in CapCut (or professional equivalent video editor) and Canva for rapid, high-quality asset design. CRM Familiarity: Proven experience navigating small business CRM frameworks, pipeline management, and client communication workflows. Visual Storytelling Eye: An exceptional eye for rhythm, color correction, and pacing in video editing—specifically maximizing the "oddly satisfying" nature of exterior cleaning transformations. Flawless Written English: Perfect command of English grammar and professional tone. Ability to write sophisticated captions for commercial property managers as well as engaging, punchy copy for residential homeowners. Operational Reliability: A rock-solid remote working infrastructure, including a high-spec editing computer, lightning-fast internet, and a reliable power/internet backup solution to maintain daily consistency. How to Apply (The Mandatory Screening Process) We run a disciplined, high-standards operation. To ensure you possess the intense attention to detail required to manage our systems, your application must follow these instructions exactly: Your application message must start with this exact phrase as the very first line: "Safety and Chemistry First Operations." (All applications missing this phrase will be archived automatically without review). Provide a direct link to a portfolio or Google Drive folder showcasing short-form vertical videos (Reels/TikToks/Shorts) you have personally edited and annotated. Answer this technical scenario question in 2–3 sentences: Scenario: A raw clip shows a technician cleaning a high-end window pane with a water-fed pole, but another technician in the background has briefly taken off his safety glasses while near a chemical mixing tank. How do you handle this footage during the editing and publishing process to protect the company's brand safety?

title: Content Manager: Social Media & Web (WordPress + Elementor)
job_title: Content Manager: Social Media & Web (WordPress + Elementor)
description: We're not looking for someone who's "pretty good." We need someone who's obsessive about details. The kind of person who notices when an image is 2 pixels off. Who reads a caption four times before hitting publish. Who finds typos that spell-check misses. If you've been called "picky" or "perfectionist" before—and you took it as a compliment—keep reading. What You'll Actually Be Doing Right now, we have two core needs. More will come as you grow with us. 1. Social Media Scheduling in ---------- Upload posts across Instagram, Facebook , GMB, X, and Pinterest. Add images, captions, alt tags—and make sure everything is polished before it goes live. You'll work inside Sprout Social, which handles all platforms in one place. If you haven't used Sprout, we'll train you. And the skills will make you more marketable if we ever part ways. 2. Web Content in WordPress + Elementor Place content on pages. Follow our standards for styling, spacing, image handling, and metadata. You’ll also create and categorize pages intelligently. If you've used Elementor before, great. If not, we'll train you—but you need to be comfortable in WordPress already. You do not need to be a designer, but you need to know if something looks good or not. That's the work. It's repetitive. It requires focus. And it must be nearly error-free because our clients have zero tolerance for sloppy presentation. We're saying that out loud so you can self-select. If you thrive on variety and hate repeating tasks, or you’re just looking for something to pay you, this isn't for you. Vital info: In your application, use this phrase somewhere so we know you actually read this: "detail-driven" We expect general competencies in typing, Google Workspace, Gmail, Google Drive, and all of the other Google Apps. We also expect you to be self-managed and proactive. You should expect that out of yourself as well. You may have other VA-type tasks assigned to you as well. We may even need some assistance with AI in writing and running assessments and checks. Have a background in SEO or design? Let us know! Who We're Hoping to Find We realize our budget is entry-level. We're not hiding that. What we offer in exchange: real training, meaningful work, and a long-term home if you're the COMMITTED kind of person who grows with the companies you join. We've built this agency on relationships, not revolving doors. If you’re younger and getting going, come aboard. If you’re more experienced but without work, read on… So who fits? • A social media manager who wants hands-on experience with Sprout and a more technical workflow. • A web designer or WordPress builder who wants more exposure to other areas of digital marketing and content strategy. • A VA or data entry professional looking to level up into WordPress, Elementor, and real marketing projects. • A project manager or strategist between gigs who wants to get your foot in the door and prove your skills—even if the starting rate is lower than you'd normally take. Come show your value and we may have another place for you. If you're motivated, reliable, and obsessively detail-oriented? We want to hear from you. Requirements • Equipped with a reliable computer and stable internet connection • Able to meet via video call 2–3x per week with management (up to 5 the first few weeks) • Willing to produce brief daily reports in our time-tracking software • Comfortable learning new industry-leading online tools (we'll train the right person) • Available 4–8 hours per day, consistently (you can let us know what works for you) Compensation USD $3-$4/hour depending on experience (starting). We pay bi-weekly initially to get you some fuel and build trust for the 1st three pay periods and monthly thereafter. There's room to grow as you prove yourself—this is meant to be a long-term fit, not a quick gig. Want a Long-Term Career? We take our investments in our partners seriously. Ideally, we’d like this to work ou,t and you continue without agency. Here’s how it works: We Dance, We Date, We Marry: All independent contractors entering our organization enter into a probationary period of one month, followed by three months (minimum) before we commit to anything longer. We operate in this manner to determine fit, climate/cultural countenance, and to ensure you are in “the right seat on the bus.” To Apply Do not reply here with a generic message. We will not respond. Instead: Submit your application via this form: ---------- Then reply here to confirm you submitted the form. If you only reply here without using the form, your application won't be considered. You’d be amazed at how many people on here don’t follow directions and keep following up. Thanks!

Company: Simply Nootropics
Location: Remote
Position Type: Full-Time

About Us

Simply Nootropics is a fast-growing, performance-driven supplement e-commerce company based in New Zealand. We develop scientifically formulated supplements and nootropics designed to support longevity, anti-ageing, brain health, stress resilience, and cognitive performance. Our customers span New Zealand, Australia, Singapore, and increasingly Europe and the USA. We are focused on building a premium global brand grounded in science, operational excellence, and high-impact creative execution. Our team is ambitious, accountable, and collaborative. We value strong systems, clear communication, and delivering work we’re genuinely proud of.

The Role

The Creative Project Coordinator is the operational backbone of the Creative Team. This role ensures projects move efficiently from brief to delivery, deadlines are met, feedback loops don’t stall production, and assets are delivered to a consistently high standard.

You will act as the quality gate between the Creative Team and the Head of Creative, maintaining structure, clarity, and accountability across all marketing channels. This role is ideal for someone highly systems-oriented, detail-focused, and confident managing multiple parallel workflows in a fast-paced eCommerce environment.

Project & Workflow Coordination (35%)
- Coordinate briefs, timelines, and deliverables across the Creative Team
- Own and maintain the marketing calendar, ensuring deadlines are clearly communicated and consistently met across all channels and campaigns
- Surface blockers early and keep work moving without needing to be chased
- Help manage feedback loops across all marketing channels — web, email, paid social, organic social, and community — to ensure input and approvals don't stall production
- Keep project management tooling accurate, up to date, and consistently used across the team

Quality Assurance & Review (20%)
- Review all creative assets and deliverables before they reach the Head of Creative or external stakeholders
- Maintain QA/QC checklists across channels and formats, flagging errors, inconsistencies, and off-brand work
- Act as the quality gate between the Creative Team and the Head of Creative

Asset Management (15%)
- Own the creative asset library with naming conventions, version control, folder structure, and archiving
- Ensure assets are organised, accessible, and up to date across all markets and channels
- Manage incoming and outgoing files between internal teams and external partners

Creative Briefing Support (5%)
- Review briefs for completeness and flag gaps before they reach the creative team
- Maintain a brief library and ensure consistency in how briefs are structured across channels

Reporting & Documentation (5%)
- Compile and maintain recurring creative reports and performance summaries across channels
- Track creative output volumes, status dashboards, and on-time delivery rates
- Keep internal documentation current — briefs, process docs, templates, and team references

Meeting Coordination & Team Communication (5%)
- Schedule and manage recurring pod meetings, team meetings, and cross-functional check-ins
- Coordinate across time zones to ensure the full team is aligned and no one is consistently left out of key conversations
- Maintain meeting cadences, send agendas where needed, and ensure notes and action items are documented and accessible

Budget & Production Spend Tracking (5%)
- Track creative production costs, POs, and invoices against budget
- Flag overruns or anomalies to the Head of Creative
- Maintain a running view of spend across vendors, tools, and production
- Operational Systems & Process Compliance (5%)
- Monitor how the team's tools are being used day-to-day, identifying gaps where processes aren't being followed or tools aren't being used to their full potential
- Serve as the go-to resource for tool-related questions, helping the team work within established systems correctly and consistently
- Flag recurring workarounds or process breakdowns to the Head of Creative and recommend solutions

Requirements/Experience:
- 3+ years in a project coordination, creative operations, or marketing operations role
- Experience supporting a Creative or Marketing team
- Experience in eCommerce or DTC environments preferred

Systems & Tools:
- Strong experience using ClickUp (or similar PM tool) to manage workflows and reporting
- Confident reviewing and managing feedback in Figma & Frame.io
- Experience maintaining structured asset systems in Google Drive
- Proficient in Google Sheets for tracking and dashboards
- Comfortable working in Slack and remote, cross-timezone teams

Preferred:
- Familiarity with email platforms (e.g., Klaviyo)
- Familiarity with CMS tools (e.g., Shopify, Webflow, WordPress)
- Exposure to paid media environments (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads)
- Experience maintaining documentation in Notion or similar tools

What We’re Looking For:
- Highly systems-oriented and detail-driven
- Proactive in identifying blockers and solving problems early
- Comfortable managing multiple campaigns simultaneously
- Strong communicator who can coordinate across teams confidently
- Takes ownership and thrives in a fast-moving environment

How to Apply

Please send:

1. Your resume
2. A short cover note highlighting your experience with project management tools (e.g., ClickUp), Figma collaboration, asset 3. management systems, and workflow coordination
4. (Optional) Examples of dashboards, project boards, QA checklists, process documentation, asset libraries, or reporting trackers you’ve created
5. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a brief skills assessment relevant to creative workflow coordination.

Why Join Us?

- Work remotely with a globally distributed team
- Opportunity for long-term growth in a fast-scaling eCommerce brand
- Be part of an ambitious, performance-driven marketing team
- Play a key role in strengthening creative operations and delivery across multiple international markets

Join Simply Nootropics and help build the operational engine behind a growing global wellness brand.

page builder updates (e.g., Elementor or comparable tools). • Publish new magazine content (articles, issue updates, featured stories) and ensure content is properly categorized and SEO-friendly. • Troubleshoot basic site issues (broken embeds, image sizing, formatting inconsistencies) and coordinate escalations for technical fixes. 5) Podcast Distribution & RSS Feed Management • Maintain podcast RSS feed accuracy and distribution across major podcast directories and platforms. • Post episode titles, descriptions, show notes, links, and artwork updates; ensure consistency across platforms. • Support content syndication workflows and verify successful publishing and propagation of updates. 6) Reporting, Systems & Collaboration • Track performance metrics and provide weekly reporting (basic KPIs, top posts, growth observations, next-week priorities). • Communicate status and deliverables clearly via Microsoft Teams and shared trackers (Google Sheets/Excel). • Use ChatGPT and/or AI tools to accelerate drafting and ideation while maintaining accuracy, tone, and brand integrity. • Follow SOPs, file naming conventions, and internal workflows; maintain strong attention to detail in every deliverable. Required Tools & Technical Proficiency • Adobe Photoshop (required) • Adobe InDesign (required) — or comparable professional layout tool with proven portfolio examples • Adobe After Effects (required) — or comparable motion graphics tool (portfolio required) • Video editing workflow (Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable) • WordPress (required) — including page builders such as Elementor or comparable • Microsoft Teams (required) • PowerPoint (required) • Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets) and/or Microsoft 365 • Scheduling and publishing tools (Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Later, Hootsuite, or comparable) You Must Be • A creative producer with strong visual taste who can execute quickly without sacrificing quality. • Highly organized and dependable — able to manage multiple brands, deadlines, and asset pipelines. • A strong written communicator — professional English writing is required. • Tech-savvy and resourceful — comfortable learning new tools and following SOPs. • Accountable and proactive — you take ownership and communicate issues early. Task 4 – WordPress Publishing & Website Update (Screenshots) • Demonstrate your WordPress editing experience by providing screenshots of work you have done (or a sample on a staging/demo site). • Show: creating/updating a post, adding an image, embedding a YouTube video or podcast player, and formatting headings/links. • Include a brief 5–8 step written workflow describing how you perform weekly website updates. description: I am a former lawyer and now run a specialist law-firm SEO & website agency based in Sydney, Australia, and I’m looking for a long-term **Website Delivery Lead** to own our web projects end?to?end. We build and rebuild websites for boutique law firms and regulated advisory practices. Our clients are serious, professional, and expect calm, authoritative websites – not loud e?commerce designs. We already have a solid Elementor developer on the team. What we need now is a **leader for web delivery**: someone who can translate strategy and copy into page structures, manage implementation, and guide projects smoothly from kickoff to launch. This is a long-term role for someone who wants to grow into a leadership position inside a small, specialist team – **not** a short-term side gig or “one of many clients.” ABOUT THE ROLE ???? You will: - Join key client calls (kickoff + selected feedback calls) with me. - Turn strategy notes + copy into page structures, wireframes, and clear dev briefs. - Manage and QA our existing Elementor developer (and any future devs): - Create tasks, Looms, and checklists - Review work against our standards - Ensure deadlines are met - Implement changes yourself in Elementor when needed (especially fine?tuning and smaller builds). - Apply our SEO & CRO best-practice checklists. - Own website timelines from kickoff to launch (usually 6–8 weeks per build). Over time, you become the person who “owns” website delivery so projects run smoothly and clients feel looked after. SUPPORT & GROWTH ???? This is a **leadership track** role, and I don’t expect you to be perfect on day one. You will get: - **1:1 support fro ---------- ** (founder) – regular calls, private Looms, and direct feedback. - Clear **templates, checklists, and examples** for how we structure law-firm sites. - Coaching on: - How to run web projects with law-firm partners - How to handle client feedback and push back calmly when needed - How to brief developers clearly and review their work If you are ambitious and want to grow into a true leadership role (owning a function, not just tasks), this is what we are building this role for. REQUIREMENTS ? Must have: - 3+ years working with **WordPress + Elementor** on real client projects. - Experience building sites for **professional services / B2B** (law, consulting, finance, SaaS, healthcare, agencies, etc.). - Strong & clear **spoken and written English** – comfortable on Zoom with professional clients. Accent is fine; clarity and confidence matter. - Solid project-management skills: can manage timelines, scopes, and feedback without drama. - High attention to detail, especially on mobile layouts. Nice to have (bonus, not required): - Previous experience with **law firms** or other regulated / conservative industries. - Basic understanding of on?page SEO (H1/H2 structure, internal linking, meta basics). We will train you on our specific law-firm patterns, templates, and checklists. HOURS, RATE, AND STRUCTURE ???? - Start as **part-time**: approx **20–25 hours per week** during trial. - If we work well together and pipeline supports it, this can grow into **full-time**. - Rate:  $16 AUD (Australian Dollars) per hour (or equivalent in your currency), depending on experience. - Long-term, remote contractor role with stable work if performance is strong. We’re looking for someone who wants **one main home** and stable, ongoing work – not 20 tiny clients. WHO THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT FOR ???? This is for you if: - You like the idea of **growing into a leadership role**, not just taking tickets. - You want to **own outcomes** and be trusted to run projects. - You are comfortable working with a **small, serious team** and a clear niche (law firms). - You may not feel 100% ready on client calls yet, but you **want to get there** with support and coaching. This is NOT for you if: - You want maximum variety and dozens of short projects. - You dislike client interaction and have no interest in improving that. - You are mainly an agency trying to plug in a team, not an individual contributor. HOW WE’LL START (PAID TEST) ???? 1. You apply with answers to the screening questions below. 2. If shortlisted, I’ll give you: - A **small paid test**: rebuild a law?firm hero + 1–2 sections in Elementor from my copy and notes. - A short **Loom explainer** task about a law-firm page I send you. 3. If that goes well, we start an **8-week part-time trial** on real client work with close support fro ---------- . 4. If we’re both happy, we extend long?term and increase your hours. HOW TO APPLY (SCREENING QUESTIONS) ???? Question 1: In the next 2–3 years, what do you want your work situation to look like: (a) many different short freelance projects, or (b) one primary long?term role where you become part of a single company’s team? Please explain your answer honestly. Question 2: Share links to 2–3 professional services/B2B client websites you built or led (e.g. law, consulting, finance). Record a 3–5 minute Loom (screen+voice+camera) on 1 site: what the site is for, what you personally did, key decisions/trade-offs. Question 3: Share 3–5 minute Loom (screen+voice+camera) reviewing ANY law?firm or professional?services site (not yours). : Explain what is working well, what you would change for clarity & conversion & how you would brief a developer to implement those changes. Question 4: We are based in Sydney (AEST) & most clients are in Australia. What working hours (local time) can you do that give 3–4 hrs overlap with 9am–5pm AEST, Mon–Fri? How many hrs/week can you commit now, & could you go full?time if the fit is right? Question 5: This role is budgeted at up to 16 AUD/hour (or equivalent). There may be increases over time based on performance & company results. Are you comfortable with this? Answer YES or NO & add any context. If this sounds like the kind of role and growth path you want, I’d love to hear from you.

We're looking for someone to own our content, SEO, and marketing output. This is a role you'll shape.

What you'll do
Content is the engine. Everything else flows from it.

Writing & Content
2-4 SEO-led blog posts per month about Iceland — travel guides, seasonal stories, local culture, hidden gems
Social media captions and content across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok — Facebook is our primary community with 37k+ followers; Instagram and TikTok are active growth targets
Two monthly newsletters via MailerLite — one public, one B2B/partner
WordPress publishing — uploading, formatting, scheduling
We run an active Facebook community for travellers visiting Iceland — you'll feed it with content as part of your social media output
Stay aligned with Visit Iceland and Visit Reykjavik marketing calendars and seasonal themes

SEO
Keyword research — identifying what to write based on what people actually search for
On-page SEO — title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking across all content
Content planning driven by search intent and keyword opportunity
Google Search Console — regular monitoring, tracking rankings, flagging drops, identifying quick wins
Google Analytics — understanding what content drives traffic and conversions
Technical SEO basics — site audits, crawl issues, page speed flags, schema where relevant
Local SEO — Google Business Profile optimisation, Iceland-specific search behaviour
AI search visibility — monitoring and improving YFIR's presence in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini responses via Visby
Competitor content analysis — understanding what's ranking and why

Video
Edit short-form social video — Reels, TikToks, and Stories — from raw footage we supply
Create engaging edits with subtitles, music, hooks, and pacing suited to each platform
TikTok content should be native-feeling — not repurposed Instagram content
You won't be shooting — we supply the raw material, you make it work

Podcast (launching soon)
Edit and produce our podcast/chatshow — recorded conversations, interviews, Iceland stories
Handle audio cleanup, structure, chapter markers, and show notes
Publish and distribute via our podcast hosting platform
Repurpose episodes into social clips, TikToks, and newsletter content

Reporting
Monthly performance reporting via Reportz covering SEO, social, newsletter, and video metrics
Track hours per task area using Toggl
Flag what's working, what isn't, and what to do about it

The multiplier in practice: one recorded conversation becomes a podcast episode, TikTok clips, Instagram Reels, a newsletter feature, and an SEO-optimised blog post. That's the leverage this role creates.

Tool

Claude
AI writing, research, content drafting, and repurposing

Social media scheduling and publishing across all platforms including TikTok

SEO monitoring and traffic analysis


What we're looking for
You are genuinely interested in Iceland.
Not 'Iceland seems nice' interested. Actually curious — about the history, the folklore, the landscapes, the culture, the food, the people. You don't need to have been here. But you need to care enough that writing about Iceland feels like a privilege, not a task. If Iceland is just a backdrop, this isn't the right fit.

Writing is the foundation.
You write clearly, warmly, and with personality. You can adapt tone — conversational for travel audiences, professional for B2B partners. You don't write like a chatbot and you don't write like a press release.

SEO is a genuine skill, not a checkbox.
You understand how search works — keyword intent, on-page structure, what makes content rank versus what makes it just exist. You write for humans first and search engines second, and you know how to do both simultaneously. Bonus if you understand GEO — how AI models like ChatGPT and Claude surface travel content.

AI fluency is non-negotiable.
We want someone who has genuinely built AI into their daily workflow — using it to research faster, draft quicker, find keyword opportunities, repurpose content smarter — while producing output that still sounds like a person wrote it. Show us how you work, not just that you use it.

Video editing is real, not decorative.
You know CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, or equivalent. You understand what makes a TikTok stop a scroll in the first two seconds. Short-form travel content experience is a strong plus.

TikTok and Instagram are growth priorities.
Our main following lives on Facebook — over 37,000 followers. Now we want to grow. Instagram and TikTok are the two platforms where we're actively building presence, and this hire plays a central role in that.

You thrive wearing multiple hats.
On Monday you might be deep in keyword research. On Tuesday you're editing for social media. On Wednesday you're writing a newsletter. The right person finds that energising, not overwhelming.

You track your time without being asked.
We use Toggl to log hours per task area. This isn't about surveillance — it's about understanding where time goes so we can scope the role fairly and adjust over time if needed.

Podcast editing is a bonus, not a barrier.
If you've edited audio before — removed filler, cleaned levels, structured a conversation — great. If you're willing to learn, tell us.

Beyond the above:
Social media management across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok
Comfortable with WordPress — publishing, formatting, images

Self-managed — you deliver without daily check-ins
English fluency required. Additional languages are a bonus

Location: Fully remote — anywhere with good English and reliable internet
Timezone: Flexible, with occasional overlap with GMT

Skip the generic cover letter. Include these two things instead:

1. A writing sample.
Either something you've already written about travel, or a 250-300 word blog intro written for this application. Topic: 'Why Iceland in January is better than you think.' You can use AI — we'll judge the output, not whether you used it.

2. A short note on your AI workflow.
In 100-150 words: how do you use AI tools in your content, SEO, or video work? What tools, what for, and what do you still do yourself?

Bonus: If you have a video edit, TikTok portfolio, podcast clip, or SEO case study to share, include a link.

title: SEO Specialist: WordPress & Shopify (3+ Years Experience)
job_title: SEO Specialist: WordPress & Shopify (3+ Years Experience)
description: ## About Us Fuel Results is a digital marketing agency based in the United States. We handle SEO, web design, PPC, CRO, and content for a portfolio of clients across industries, from ecommerce brands to law firms to industrial manufacturers. We care about real results, not vanity metrics, and we're looking for someone who thinks the same way. ## The Role We're hiring an experienced SEO Specialist to execute day-to-day SEO work across our client portfolio. You'll handle everything from new-client technical setup to ongoing on-page optimization and off-site link building. You'll be working alongside our content writers, web developers, and other specialists. This is a role for someone who can work independently, communicates proactively, and actually enjoys SEO. We're not looking for someone who just wants to tick boxes on a checklist. ## How This Role Works - **Part-time to start, with potential for full-time hours in the future.** - We give out assignments. You clock in, work on what we assign you, and bill us for your hours. - **Weekly payouts.** ## What You'll Be Doing **New Client Onboarding & Technical SEO** - Set up Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, and Google Search Console (and connect them properly) - Install and configure Rank Math and WP Rocket on WordPress sites - Set up SEMrush projects including position tracking (local + nationwide), keyword tracking, GSC connection, GA connection - Build the initial SEO report and automate it to run monthly (domain overview, on-page audit, keyword rankings, site health, traffic insights, backlink audit) - Full technical audit on every new site: SSL, XML sitemap submission, robots.txt review, mobile-friendliness, caching, JS/CSS minification, lazy loading, image compression (Imagify), schema validation, canonical tags, redirect chains, www vs non-www, duplicate meta titles/descriptions, broken links, GSC coverage issues, manual penalty checks **Keyword Research & Strategy** - Competitor keyword gap analysis against top 3 competitors - Identify 100+ target keywords per client - Map keywords to the site structure and existing pages **Ongoing On-Page SEO** - Optimize H1s, H2–H6s, intro sentences, slugs, alt text, and featured images for target keywords - Build out internal linking with strong anchor text - Make sure blogs have 2–3 relevant external links - Identify and eliminate content cannibalization - Ensure social markup and social sharing are enabled on blogs - Sitewide alt-text audits **Off-Page SEO & Outreach** - Manual link building and outreach - Coordinate guest posts with our in-house content writers - Coordinate press releases with our writers when applicable - Pursue joint offers, brand collabs, and partnership opportunities - Dead-link outreach - Network for link opportunities (OpenCoffee-style meetups or online communities where relevant) ## Tools You'll Use Daily SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Rank Math, WP Rocket, Imagify, Screaming Frog (or similar), Google's schema testing tool, WordPress, Shopify ## Requirements (Must Have) - **Minimum 3 years of hands-on SEO experience.** This is non-negotiable. - Proven experience doing SEO on **both WordPress and Shopify** - Deep familiarity with SEMrush (or comparable tools like Ahrefs) - Comfortable with technical SEO: schema, redirects, canonicals, sitemap/robots.txt, Core Web Vitals, GSC troubleshooting - Experience with manual link building and outreach (not just cold spam, but relationship-based outreach) - Strong written and spoken English, since you'll be writing outreach email s and communicating with our team - Reliable internet and ability to work independently - Organized, since you'll be tracking work across multiple clients ## Nice to Have - Experience with Rank Math and WP Rocket specifically - Experience writing or reviewing SEO content briefs - Digital PR or HARO experience - Local SEO experience (GMB/Google Business Profile) - Experience with cannibalization analysis tools ## How to Apply If you've made it this far and you're the right fit, here's what we need from you: 1. Start your application with the phrase **"Fuel Me Up"**. We ignore applications that don't include this. It's how we filter out mass applicants. 2. Tell us about 2–3 SEO clients you've worked on. For each, include: the niche, the platform (WordPress or Shopify), what you did, and the result (ranking improvements, traffic growth, links built, etc.). Screenshots of SEMrush/GSC/GA are a big plus. 3. Tell us which SEO tools you're most comfortable with. 4. Tell us your hourly rate and how many hours per week you can commit to starting out. 5. Confirm you're comfortable with a time-tracking / clock-in system and weekly hourly billing. We're excited to find the right person. Looking forward to hearing from you.

description: OVERVIEW RMD is a digital agency with clients in 20+ countries. Compensation: $350 to $550 USD per month based on experience, paid via PayPal. Hours: 40 hours per week, Manila time. WHAT YOU WILL DO Take content briefs from our senior writer (blog posts, landing pages, service pages) and build the page in WordPress + Elementor (or hand-coded HTML/CSS, your choice) Set up the on-page SEO basics on every page you build: meta title, meta description, H1, image alt text, internal links, schema where relevant. Yoast or RankMath Run weekly site-health checks: broken links, slow pages, missing meta data, indexing issues. Flag what you find Submit sitemaps, request indexing in Google Search Console, monitor for crawl errors Help with simple on-page audits: open a page, list what's wrong, suggest fixes Make small content updates: typo fixes, link swaps, image replacements, schedule blog posts Read Google Analytics and Google Search Console at a basic level. We'll teach you the rest WHAT YOU NEED ON DAY ONE This is a junior role and we will teach you the advanced parts. But you walk in with these or you don't walk in. Strong WordPress + Elementor. You can build a clean landing page from a brief. You know your way around Elementor templates, global colors, mobile responsive view OR strong hand-coded HTML/CSS. If you prefer to code pages by hand, we accept that. Show us the work Basic on-page SEO knowledge. You know what a meta title is, why H1 matters, what alt text is for, how internal links help Yoast or RankMath setup experience on at least one real WordPress site. Configured the basics: meta title template, sitemap, breadcrumbs, redirects. Not the install-and-leave-default version Basic image work in Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent. Resize, crop, export at correct dimensions, compress for web (no 5MB hero images) Hosting + Cloudflare basics. You can log into a cPanel / hosting dashboard, find files, change DNS records, clear a cache. You don't need to be a sysadmin, just not afraid of the back-end At least one of Ahrefs, Semrush, or Google Search Console used on a real project. Even at a beginner level. You've opened the tool, run a query, and used the output for something real 1+ year of digital agency, freelance, or in-house web/SEO work. Hobby projects don't count. We need someone who has shipped under deadline pressure You can read a page and spot what's broken or sloppy. Missing alt text, broken links, walls of text with no headings, slow images. You notice You can read English well. Our briefs are in English. Some clients are French (we translate the brief, you don't need French) Honesty about what you don't know. "I haven't done schema before, but I can learn" beats "yes I know schema" followed by a mess BONUS (NOT REQUIRED, BUT MOVES YOU UP THE LIST) 1+ live URL you built or wrote that ranks on page 1 of Google for any commercial keyword. Send: URL + target keyword + screenshot from Ahrefs / Semrush / live SERP. This is a strong plus 1 URL where you can show conversion data (CVR%, leads/month, GA4 or GSC screenshot, redacted is fine). Most juniors don't have this; if you do, it puts you ahead Schema markup deployment (FAQPage, Article, Product) in production Shopify (we have e-commerce clients) 2+ years of agency or freelance work French (we have clients in France and North Africa) Comfortable recording Loom walkthroughs for async comms WHO WE ARE A small team distributed across Morocco and Dubai. We work in writing, async-first, and we trust people to ship. We use AI in the daily work. We expect you to use it too, after onboarding. The test for this role does not allow AI, because we need to see what YOU can do. WHY THIS ROLE IS WORTH IT (read this part carefully) This is a junior seat, not a junior career. Here's what that means: You will get to do more, fast. Inside 90 days, if you can build clean pages and read a brief, we start handing you content briefs to write yourself, basic keyword research in Ahrefs, and small SEO audit work. Inside 6 months, you can be writing landing pages alongside our senior writer. Inside 12 months, ownership of small clients is on the table. We teach the advanced parts. Schema, technical SEO, GA4 + GSC diagnostics, Yoast/RankMath setup at a real level, AI-assisted content workflow, internal linking architecture, topic clusters. We don't gatekeep. If you want to learn it, we'll teach it. We reward progress. Learn a new skill, ship a harder deliverable, hit a result we didn't expect. When that happens, we adjust your pay and scope to match. We don't make people wait 2 years for a real raise. A-players see significant pay growth (50% to 80%+) inside the first year. The ceiling is what you make of it. We don't have a "you're a junior, stay in your lane" culture. The people who grow inside RMD become senior writers, content leads, and SEO specialists. You d ---------- how fast. Who this is NOT for: people who want to stay junior forever and improve very slowly. We hire people who want to move forward. If "comfortable, low-pressure, no growth" is the goal, this isn't the seat. Apply somewhere else, no hard feelings. HOW TO APPLY Reply to this post with your CV Include a portfolio link (Google Drive folder, personal site, GitHub, anything). We need to see at least 2 WordPress pages or HTML pages you built. Screenshots are fine, live URLs are better Start your email body with the line: RMD RMD. (Yes, exactly those two words on the first line. This is how we know you actually read the post.) Tell us in 2 to 3 sentences: what's the most recent page you built or content you integrated? What did you do, what tools did you use? If your application makes our shortlist, we will email you 3 quick screening questions. Reply to those, and if you pass, we send a free 45-minute practical test. The test is small and clear. You'll see the scoring before you start. We reply within 5 business days if we want to move you forward. We are a small team and don't have a dedicated recruiter. If you don't hear from us in that window, your application wasn't a fit this round. Don't take it personally and please don't chase. We respect your time enough to be honest about that. WHAT NOT TO SEND Generic CVs with no portfolio "I am hardworking and loyal" cover letters with no specifics Promises you can do everything (we know nobody can) We're hiring one person for this role. We're patient. We will wait for the right fit. Apply on OnlineJobs.ph or email ---------- with subject "SEO Integrator PH, [Your Full Name]"

job_title: Expert SEO / AEO Specialist (Full time, Remote, Long-Term)
description: WHO WE ARE We're a performance-focused digital agency that takes SEO and organic growth seriously not as an add-on service, but as the core of what we do. We work with ambitious clients who want to win in search, and we need experts who are obsessed with making that happen. We're not looking for generalists who dabble in SEO between other tasks. We want a specialist who wakes up thinking about algorithm updates, tests hypotheses on weekends, and gets a genuine buzz from watching a client climb from page 3 to position 1. If that sounds like you read on. THE ROLE This is a senior, hands-on SEO/AEO Specialist role for someone who can own an entire search strategy not just execute tasks handed down from above. You'll work directly with clients and internal stakeholders, leading the research, strategy, execution, and reporting that drives measurable organic growth. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) is no longer optional  it's where search is heading. You'll be expected to understand and actively optimise for AI-driven answers, featured snippets, voice search, and the rapidly evolving landscape of LLM-influenced SERPs. If you haven't heard of AEO or GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), this isn't the right role for you. WHAT YOU'LL DO Strategy & Planning - Develop comprehensive, data-led SEO and AEO strategies tailored to each client's industry, competition, and business objectives - Conduct deep-dive keyword research, competitive gap analysis, and search intent mapping going beyond volume to understand what drives conversions - Stay ahead of Google algorithm updates, SERP feature changes, and AI-generated result behaviours (SGE, Gemini, ChatGPT citations) and adapt strategies accordingly - Build and present strategy documents and roadmaps that clients actually understand and get excited about Technical SEO - Perform thorough technical audits covering crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, site architecture, structured data (schema), and mobile performance - Diagnose and resolve technical issues that are preventing pages from ranking not just document them, but fix them or work directly with developers to get them fixed - Implement and validate schema markup for rich results: FAQs, How-Tos, Articles, Products, People, and more critical for AEO performance - Audit and optimise for E-E-A-T signals across the site On-Page & Content Optimisation - Optimise existing content and brief new content to capture featured snippets, People Also Ask boxes, AI overviews, and other zero-click SERP features - Conduct content gap analysis and develop topical authority frameworks that position clients as the go-to source in their niche - Optimise page structure, meta data, headings, and internal linking with precision nothing sloppy, nothing template-driven - Guide content teams on SEO best practices: search intent alignment, NLP optimisation, conversational query targeting, and FAQ structuring for AEO Off-Page & Authority Building - Develop and execute ethical, white-hat link building strategies digital PR, resource pages, broken link building, HARO/journalist outreach - Audit backlink profiles, disavow toxic links, and track referring domain growth over time - Identify and pursue unlinked brand mention opportunities Reporting & Communication - Deliver clear, insightful monthly reports that tie SEO activity to business outcomes not vanity metrics, but leads, revenue, and ROI - Use GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush, Screaming Frog, and Looker Studio with fluency - Communicate proactively — flag wins, flag problems, and always show up with a solution WHAT YOU BRING We will ask you to prove everything on this list. Come prepared. - 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with a strong portfolio of measurable ranking and traffic improvements across multiple industries - Demonstrated AEO experience: optimising for featured snippets, PAA, voice search, and AI overviews (SGE / Gemini) - Deep technical SEO proficiency — you can read a crawl log, interpret a Core Web Vitals report, and debug a canonical issue without hand-holding - Expert-level command of: Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, GA4, Google Search Console, and at least one reporting/data visualisation tool (Looker Studio, Data Studio) - Strong understanding of schema markup and structured data implementation ideally hands-on, not just theoretical - A clear understanding of how LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) are surfacing content, and how to optimise for citation and inclusion in AI-generated answers - Solid grasp of on-page copywriting principles you don't need to be a writer, but you need to write and review briefs that make writers produce content that ranks - Experience working in an agency environment, managing multiple client accounts simultaneously - Excellent written English — your reports, audits, and strategy docs are polished and professional - Reliable, fast internet connection and a dedicated, distraction-free workspace BONUS POINTS You don't need all of these, but they'll make us pay attention: - Experience with international or multilingual SEO and hreflang implementation - WordPress, Shopify, or headless CMS technical knowledge - Experience optimising for Google Business Profile and local SEO - Familiarity with Python or Google Apps Script for SEO automation - Published writing, conference talks, or contributions to the SEO community (blogs, Twitter /X, LinkedIn) - Experience with Programmatic SEO or content scaling strategies WHO YOU ARE Skills matter. But so does the kind of person you are to work with. We're looking for someone who: - Takes ownership. You don't wait to be told what to fix you find it, flag it, and fix it. - Is obsessively curious. Algorithm dropped? You're already reading the analysis on X and testing on your own sites. - Communicates with clarity. No corporate waffle. Say what you mean, mean what you say, and write it in plain English. - Is honest and accountable. Rankings go down. Traffic dips. We want someone who explains what happened and what we're doing about it — not someone who buries the bad news. - Loves learning. SEO in 2025 looks nothing like SEO in 2020. You've kept up — and you're ready for wherever it goes next. HOW TO APPLY We read every application carefully. Here's how to stand out: - Submit your CV with a clear summary of your SEO experience and the tools you use daily - Include 2–3 case studies or examples of campaigns you've led — show us the before/after, what you did, and the results - In the subject line of your application, write: "I actually read the job description" — this tells us you pay attention to detail - Optional but impressive: share a quick Loom video (under 3 minutes) walking us through a piece of SEO work you're proud of Applications without relevant SEO experience or examples will not be considered. We're serious about finding the right person, and we know that takes time.

title: GoHighLevel Build Executor — Mortgage Automation System (Part-Time, Long-Term)

description: READ THIS FIRST This is not an architect's role. The systems are already designed. The workflows, copy, doc lists, and pipeline logic are already written. THE PROJECT I'm building a complete mortgage lead capture and nurture system in GoHighLevel for a US-based Senior Loan Officer in Phoenix, Arizona. Every workflow node. Every condition. Every email body. Every SMS message. Every tag. Every custom field value. Your job is to execute them inside GoHighLevel with zero deviation. Typical week: Building and editing workflows in GoHighLevel (If/Else conditions, wait timers, email actions, SMS actions, tag actions, pipeline stage moves) Configuring pipelines, opportunities, tags, and custom fields exactly as specified Setting up email templates with merge fields, footers, and reply-to addresses Configuring SMS templates with custom values and merge fields Managing A2P 10DLC registrations end-to-end — brand registration, campaign builds, sample message review, handling carrier rejections and resubmissions, monitoring trust scores. As we productize this system into a resellable snapshot, every new Loan Officer client who buys it will need their own A2P 10DLC setup. You will own this process. Building forms and embedding them on landing pages Setting up webhooks and verifying they fire correctly Configuring calendars and booking links Testing every workflow end-to-end with test submissions before marking it done Recording short Loom videos showing me what you built so I can verify it matches spec Documenting any deviations or questions (don't guess — ask) Cleaning up orphan workflow branches, broken conditions, and inconsistent tags Maintaining a clean snapshot ready for resale to other Loan Officers NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS You must have: 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience — not "I watched tutorials," actual building inside client sub-accounts Strong understanding of GHL workflows: triggers, If/Else conditions, Wait actions, Send Email , Send SMS, Add/Remove Tag, Update Contact Field, Find Opportunity, Go To actions Custom fields and custom values — you know the difference and when to use each Pipeline and opportunity management — moving opportunities between stages via workflows Webhook trigger experience — receiving form data via webhook and mapping it to contact fields Email and SMS template building with merge fields and custom values A2P 10DLC verification expertise — you have personally taken at least one client through the full A2P 10DLC registration process inside GoHighLevel and gotten approved. You know: How to register the brand (EIN, business info, website, privacy policy requirements) How to build the campaign and write sample messages that pass carrier review What gets campaigns rejected (vague opt-in language, missing STOP/HELP, mismatched use case, weak privacy policy) and how to fix it How to handle resubmissions when carriers push back Trust score implications and how to improve a low score The difference between brand approval and campaign approval, and what each unlocks Strong written English — you'll read detailed specs and need to communicate clearly when something is unclear Extreme attention to detail — a tag spelled "Lead Captured" vs "lead-captured" silently breaks a workflow. You catch that before I do. Self-discipline to follow instructions exactly — if the spec says "wait 30 minutes," you don't change it to 1 hour because you think it's better Reliable internet + quiet workspace + ability to record Loom videos NICE TO HAVE (BONUS POINTS) Spanish language skills (the system is bilingual — knowing Spanish lets you spot if Spanish copy is wrong, but I'll handle Spanish QA myself if you don't) Mortgage industry exposure Experience with Arive (mortgage LOS) — we'll be syncing GHL ? Arive in Sprint 2 Zapier or Make.com experience for integrations Snapshot creation and white-label deployment experience AI bot configuration inside GHL (Conversation AI / playbooks) THE PERSON I'M LOOKING FOR Green flags: You test your own work before saying "done" You record a quick Loom showing what you built — you don't make me hunt for it You ask clarifying questions before building, not after breaking something You spot inconsistencies in specs and flag them You say "I don't know that, but I can learn it" instead of pretending You hit deadlines and communicate when you can't You treat the GHL account like your own business Red flags (don't apply if): You need someone holding your hand on every click You change things "because you thought it was better" without asking You disappear for days without communication You exaggerate your GHL experience You wait for instructions instead of executing the spec in front of you COMPENSATION + GROWTH Starting: $300–$400/month for 20 hours/week (rate based on experience proven in interview) Performance bonuses when we hit launch milestones Raises as you prove yourself and take on more responsibility Long-term role — when the snapshot productization scales, the person who knows the system best becomes more valuable, not less Paid time off and holidays added over time for long-term team members HOW TO APPLY Send a message with ALL of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed — this is the first test of whether you follow detailed instructions. 1. Start your message with the exact phrase: "PURPLE MORTGAGE" (This proves you read the full post. No "purple mortgage," no "Purple-Mortgage," no creative variations. Exact match.) 2. A short paragraph (3–5 sentences) about your GoHighLevel experience: how many years, what types of clients/industries you've built for, and what you'd say is your strongest skill inside GHL. 3. A 2–4 minute Loom video walking me through ONE workflow you've personally built inside GoHighLevel. Show me the canvas, explain what each node does, and tell me what problem the workflow solved. No Loom = no review. If you've never built a workflow you can show, this role is not for you. 4. Answer this question in writing: A form submits to a GHL webhook. The form sends a field called preferred_language with values english or spanish. The workflow has an If/Else condition checking if Preferred Language (custom field) equals English. After submission, the contact is created correctly but the workflow always goes down the "None" branch even for English leads. What are the top 3 things you would check to debug this? 5. Answer this A2P 10DLC question in writing (this is non-negotiable — your answer tells me immediately whether you've actually done this work): A client's A2P 10DLC campaign was rejected by the carrier with the reason: "Sample messages do not match the registered use case and opt-in language is unclear." Tell me about one client you took through A2P 10DLC registration. How long did it take? Was it approved on first submission or did you have to resubmit? What was the hardest part? 7. Your weekly availability in PH time, and how many hours per week overlap with US Pacific Time (Phoenix / Arizona). 8. Your internet speed test link (speedtest.net result screenshot or link). 9. Your monthly rate expectation for 20 hours/week. FINAL NOTE This role is for executors, people who love being given a clear plan and bringing it to life flawlessly. The system architecture is locked. What I need is a precision builder who can take my specs and turn them into working automation, week after week, while the snapshot grows into a resellable product. over time — Diagnose crawl, indexation, rendering, and structured data issues using Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or equivalent tools — Develop and prioritize optimization roadmaps based on audit findings, search data, and business impact — Review and improve site architecture, internal linking strategies, URL structures, and crawl efficiency — Audit and implement schema markup (FAQ, LocalBusiness, Article, HowTo, etc.) across client sites On-Page & Content Optimization Direction — Define on-page optimization requirements for blog posts, service pages, and location pages published content for SEO quality and flag issues before they compound — Guide keyword targeting and content gap analysis to inform the editorial calendar GEO / Generative Engine Optimization — Optimize client content for visibility in AI-generated search results, featured snippets, and answer engine experiences — Structure content to satisfy entity-based search, question-intent queries, and knowledge graph signals — Stay current on how Google SGE, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, and ChatGPT Search surface and cite content, and adapt strategies accordingly — Implement and refine structured data to improve content eligibility for rich results and AI citations Reporting & Founder Collaboration — Track key SEO metrics (rankings, organic traffic, indexation, CTR, featured snippet capture) and report on progress — Join weekly or biweekly syncs with the founder to discuss strategy, audit findings, and client priorities — Document recurring SEO processes and build lightweight SOPs as workflows stabilize What This Role Is Not — Not a blog-writing or content-creation role (we have writers and an execution team for that) — Not a general virtual assistant or admin role — Not client-facing account management — Not social media management or graphic design — Not WordPress development or plugin/theme coding Tools You Will Use Training provided for any tools you have not used before, but you must be proficient in the core SEO toolset. — Google Search Console (required) — Ahrefs or SEMrush (required — Ahrefs preferred) — WordPress with Rank Math (required) — Google Analytics / GA4 (required) — Screaming Frog or similar crawler (strongly preferred) — Google Sheets / Docs / Drive (required) — Schema markup generators or manual JSON-LD (required) — Slack (daily communication) — Asana (task management tool familiarity — Asana preferred) Must-Haves — Minimum 2 years of hands-on technical SEO experience (not just content SEO or on-page basics) — Demonstrated ability to run a technical SEO audit end-to-end and produce actionable findings — Strong understanding of site architecture, crawl budget, indexation, Core Web Vitals, and structured data — Working knowledge of GEO / generative engine optimization concepts and how AI search is evolving — Experience with schema markup implementation (JSON-LD preferred) — Proficiency with Ahrefs or SEMrush for keyword research, backlink analysis, and site audits — Strong WordPress experience, including Rank Math configuration — Ability to write clear optimization briefs and technical recommendations that a non-technical executor can follow — Strong written English — communication is critical in this role — Available Monday–Friday with at least 3 hours of overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–12 PM — Detail-oriented — we serve professional services clients (lawyers, healthcare) where errors are a serious problem — Reliable internet connection with a backup plan Nice-to-Haves (Not Required, But You Will Stand Out) — Experience with local SEO (Google Business Profile optimization, citation building, local pack strategy) — Familiarity with log file analysis for crawl diagnostics — Experience managing or directing junior SEO executors — Background in agency environments or managing SEO across multiple client accounts simultaneously — Understanding of programmatic SEO or template-based page optimization — Experience with Ahrefs Brand Radar or AI visibility monitoring tools — Familiarity with NLP-driven content optimization tools (Surfer, Clearscope, Frase, or similar) Hours & Working Style — Starts part-time: 10–20 hours per week, with a clear path to full-time based on performance during the evaluation period — Long-term engagement — we are building a team, not filling a one-off project — Consistent weekly availability preferred over sporadic large blocks — At least 3 hours daily overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–12 PM for real-time collaboration — Clear, proactive communication matters more than total hours logged — You will work alongside our execution VA (WordPress, publishing, formatting) and the founder (strategy, client relationships) What We Offer We treat contractors like tea ---------- mbers. Exact amount confirmed in writing based on performance and continued engagement. — Recognized Holidays — Blended Philippine and US holiday calendar agreed upon during onboarding. — Performance Bonus — Discretionary and based on quality, reliability, output, client impact, and role-specific KPIs. — Full-Time Conversion — Strong performers during the evaluation period will be offered a transition to full-time hours with expanded scope and responsibilities. 90-Day Evaluation Period: The first 90 days are a mutual evaluation period. We create online educational events that bring together leading veterinarians, pet health experts, trainers, and educators to help pet parents make better decisions for the animals they love. Our goal is to impact 1 million pet parents by the year 2030, and we are building the team, systems, and technology to make that possible. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented WordPress Technical Specialist who can help us keep our event websites, funnels, automations, reports, and technical systems running smoothly as well as build automations to improve what we already have. This is not a basic VA role. It is also not a pure programming role. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys working inside WordPress, Thrive Themes, funnels, forms, plugins, reports, dashboards, and automations, while also helping improve the way our systems work over time. Why This Role Matters Every event we run helps thousands of pet parents learn how to better care for their pets. Your work will directly support that mission. When a registration page works properly, more pet parents can attend. When forms, tags, and automations are set up correctly, people receive the right email s at the right time. When dashboards and reports are accurate, our team can make better decisions. When systems are documented and improved, the whole company becomes stronger. This role is about more than updating pages. It is about helping build the technical foundation that allows Pet Summits to grow and create more impact. What You’ll Be Doing Your main focus will be supporting the technical setup and maintenance of our online events. This includes: - Setting up and updating WordPress pages using Thrive Themes / Thrive Architect. - Moving existing event pages into new event setups, including registration pages, speaker pages, thank-you pages, replay pages, and other funnel pages. - Making sure pages are formatted correctly, mobile responsive, and ready before launch. - Updating WordPress plugins and checking that updates do not break key pages or functionality. - Testing forms, buttons, links, redirects, thank-you pages, registration flows, and other important user journeys. - Making sure Kit / ConvertKit forms, tags, and integrations are connected properly. - Testing Zapier automations and making sure data is moving correctly between tools. - Helping create and maintain reports and dashboards for event performance. - Creating and improving technical checklists, SOPs, and QA processes. - Helping us improve existing systems so our event setup process becomes more reliable, scalable, and organized. - Troubleshooting basic WordPress, plugin, page builder, form, tracking, and integration issues. The Role Breakdown Approximately 70% of this role will be WordPress, Thrive Themes, event page setup, plugin updates, testing, QA, reporting, and creating automations with Thinkific, Samcart, etc. Approximately 30% of this role will be dashboards, automations, process improvement, systems optimization, and helping us scale our infrastructure. Only want to do programming. Only know basic WordPress posting and formatting. Do not enjoy testing, checklists, details, or technical troubleshooting. Need constant supervision to complete tasks. Have unreliable internet. Avoid communicating when something is delayed or unclear. ## What’s In It For You - You’ll be part of a kind, mission-driven team doing work that genuinely helps pets and their families. - You’ll get to work on meaningful online events that reach thousands of pet parents. - You’ll have the opportunity to grow from technical execution into stronger systems, reporting, automation, and technical operations work. - You’ll be encouraged to improve processes, suggest better ways of doing things, and help build systems that scale. - You’ll be part of a company with a big vision: impacting 1 million pet parents by 2030. ## How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. Any experience with thinkific or samcart? . 4. Your salary expectations for this full-time roll 5. Examples of websites, funnels, dashboards, automations, or technical systems you have helped manage. 6. Your internet speed test screenshot. 7. A short explanation of how you would test a registration page before an event goes live. We are looking for someone reliable, thoughtful, technically capable, and excited to help us build the systems behind a mission that matters.

We will provide AI tools and workflows for translation, localization, and Bulgarian market research. But you must be smart, technical, analytical, adaptable, and experienced. Who Should Apply Apply if you: - Have real experience growing e-commerce brands - Have strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads - Understand e-commerce numbers and profit - Can analyze campaigns and create growth strategies - Can write strong marketing copy - Can work independently - Think like a growth marketer, not just an ads manager - Are comfortable with time tracking - Want a serious full-time role - Want long-term career growth with one company - Are hungry to win Do not apply if you are a beginner, only know how to post on social media, or need constant supervision. *** Test Task — Required *** Imagine you are marketing an online perfume store in Bulgaria. Send us: - A 7-day marketing action plan - A sample Meta Ads campaign structure - 3 Google Ads ideas or campaign types you would test - 3 email marketing campaign ideas - What data you would analyze first and what you would improve We want to see how you think. Generic AI answers will be ignored. *** How To Apply *** Send an email to: ---------- Subject line: Application — Digital Marketing Manager Your email must include: 1. CV / Resume - Include your digital marketing experience, brands you worked with, tools, projects, results, budgets, and strongest skills. 2. Short motivation letter - Tell us why you want this role, why you are a good fit, and why you believe you can help grow Bulgarian e-commerce brands. 3. Marketing experience overview - Tell us what you marketed, what platforms you used, what budgets you managed, and what results you achieved. 4. AI tools experience - List the AI tools you use and explain how you use them for marketing, research, copywriting, creatives, translation, and analysis. 5. Test task - Include the perfume store marketing task described above. Final Note We are not looking for a cheap VA. We are looking for a strong Digital Marketing Manager who can help us grow serious e-commerce brands. If you have strong experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, e-commerce growth, analytics, copywriting, CRO, AI tools, and performance marketing — we want to hear from you. title: SEO Specialist
description: What this role is: Locully is a Bangkok-based SEO and AI Visibility agency serving clinics, restaurants, and property companies. This role exists because too many high-value SEO tasks are sitting in a queue waiting to be published, fixed, or submitted. You'll be the person who executes — fast and correctly. This is not a "strategy" role. Strategy is handled. You implement. What you'll actually do every week: 1) Work on WordPress (daily) - Publish blog posts and pillar pages from provided drafts — correct formatting, author attribution, last updated date, internal links - Create WordPress Pages &  posts - On-Page Optimization + Content Writing are Must-Haves. 2) On-page SEO - Adding schema to pages - Update internal links across articles when new content is published - Title/meta CTR optimization - Audit thin pages and flag for content expansion 3) (Some) Link Building Outreach / Citations - Submit client profiles to directories (Wongnai, ProvenExpert, Doximity, etc.) using provided templates - Send outreach email s for link nominations using provided copy — track responses - Log all submissions in the shared tracker 4)  Reporting - Pull monthly GSC data (impressions, clicks, position, CTR) per client - Populate monthly report templates with data — we'll provide the template --- Must-haves 1) WordPress Experience : strong. You can publish a complex pillar page, build parent/child page hierarchy, add custom schema via plugin or code block, fix layout issues without a designer. Show me a page you've built. 2) English writing: clear, error-free, client-ready. Your meta descriptions, FAQ answers, and report commentary will go straight to paying clients. No typos, no awkward phrasing. 3) Outreach mindset. You're comfortable sending 30–50 personalized outreach email s per week and following up. You don't get discouraged by silence. 4) Detail-oriented. A wrong schema field, missing author attribution, or wrong URL slug breaks things downstream. You check your work before marking it done. 5) Google Search Console. You can pull performance data, inspect URLs, and read basic reports. If you can't do this yet, you can learn in week 1. 6) Self-managed. You work async, hit deadlines, and tell me when something will be late before it's late. 7) AI-assisted execution. You actively use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools in your daily SEO work. You know how to prompt for schema, content drafts, meta descriptions, and outreach copy — and you know when AI output is wrong and needs human correction. If your last SEO role was "all manual, no AI," this isn't a fit. Good to have - Ahrefs or SEMrush (reading data, not strategy) - Basic design — Canva, Figma, or enough WordPress skill to fix a broken template - Prior agency experience (multi-client environments) - Experience writing for healthcare, restaurants, or property verticals - Familiarity with AI search optimization (we'll train you regardless) How you'll work You'll use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent) to accelerate execution across every task in this role — drafting schema, expanding thin content, writing FAQ sections, personalizing outreach email s, summarizing GSC reports. We expect you to use AI as a multiplier, not as a crutch. The pattern: Prompt AI drafts 60%, you finish the last 40% with judgement, accuracy checks, correct links, removing unncessary sections and adding brand voice. Anyone who tries to do this job manually will fall behind. Anyone who pastes raw AI output into client work will be let go.
